Container.Name: nvpair
Container.Overview:
Unofficial headless container for NVIDIA Personal AI Router (PAIR), Linux/amd64. Connect this node to your PAIR cluster and route inference between paired computers. Manage it from an existing PAIR desktop client. Install Ollama and models separately.
REQUIREMENTS: Use Host networking with a healthy Ollama backend reachable at 127.0.0.1:11434 on this Unraid server. An Ollama container can publish its port to host loopback. The PAIR proxy normally listens on 11435. Port variables check expected ports; they do not reconfigure the upstream listeners. Avoid another PAIR instance on the same host.
NODE NAME: The name shown in PAIR defaults to PAIR-UNRAID. In Advanced View, change --hostname=PAIR-UNRAID in Extra Parameters (for example, --hostname=Tower-AI), then Apply. Use a unique hostname with letters, numbers, and hyphens. Changing the Unraid container Name alone does not rename the PAIR node.
NVIDIA GPU TELEMETRY (optional): Requires a working Unraid NVIDIA driver and container GPU support. For all NVIDIA GPUs, append --gpus=all to Extra Parameters, set NVIDIA GPU selection to all, and leave NVIDIA capabilities as utility. For one NVIDIA GPU, append --runtime=nvidia instead, set NVIDIA GPU selection to its GPU-... UUID, and keep utility. Obtain UUIDs with: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,uuid --format=csv,noheader Keep the existing Extra Parameters flags. Leave GPU selection as void if monitoring is not needed. Apply recreates the container so PAIR can detect GPU access at startup. These settings enable monitoring; configure Ollama GPU inference separately. AMD GPU utilization telemetry is not supported by this wrapper.
STATE AND PAIRING: The appdata directory is automatically secured at startup, then PAIR runs as UID/GID 10002:10002. Keep the same state path when renaming or updating; it contains private identity keys and preserves pairing. Never share state between nodes or publish it. Send an invitation from your PAIR desktop client, then accept in the Unraid terminal: docker exec --user=10002:10002 -it nvpair python3 /app/admin.py accept Enter the PIN shown by the inviting client. Check status with: docker exec --user=10002:10002 nvpair python3 /app/admin.py status
NETWORK ACCESS: Restrict TCP 11435, 14318-14323 and UDP 5353 to loopback and your trusted LAN, for both IPv4 and IPv6. Do not expose these services to the Internet. No WebUI is included.
Docs: https://github.com/ggee/nvpair-container Upstream: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Personal-AI-Router

Config.Name: PAIR state
Config.Description: Private state, automatically secured as UID/GID 10002 with mode 0700 at startup; contains identity keys. Never share across nodes.

Config.Name: Require local Ollama
Config.Description: Health check requires an adopted local Ollama.

Config.Name: Ollama backend port
Config.Description: Expected adopted backend port; does not relocate Ollama.

Config.Name: PAIR proxy port
Config.Description: Expected proxy port; does not configure its listener.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU selection
Config.Description: Optional telemetry: set all with --gpus=all, or a GPU UUID with --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters. Leave void to disable GPU exposure.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: Management telemetry only; Ollama separately needs compute access.
